contracts: The new planner retains initial line, area line and actual target independently; CLinker constructor finally uses reference-to-target as StemBuilder theoretical line
Page-wide item source/linker discovery, endpoint prefix selection, physical registration/cache and head relation updates remain separate integration dependencies
Original finalizeStems runs checkHeadStems for each head, using SIG.getPartitions(null,relatedStems); only partitions ofsize>1 call HeadStemsCleaner.check
Existing cleaner800 controls certify explicit supplied partitions, not the contextual partition orchestration
Original checkNeededStems only marks unlinked StemHeads abnormal=true; linked/stemless prior flags stay unchanged, undefs logs sides without retries
Native Graph.sync_stems recalculates relation callback flags; a dedicated final missing-stem operation must preserve prior linked flags, rather than imitate it by synchronizing allstems again
finalizeBeams/seed purge and original contextual grade/exclusion policy remain required
